item.title: Why AMI Labs’ Alexandre LeBrun won’t call his AI ‘AGI’ or ‘superintelligence’
item.description: While everyone in AI is chasing "superintelligence," Alexandre LeBrun, CEO of Yann LeCun’s world model startup, AMI Labs, dismisses the word.

item.title: Moonshot’s upcoming Kimi 3 is expected to close the gap with Anthropic’s Opus 4.8
item.description: The FT reports Kimi K3 will be the largest open AI model from China, with a parameter count between 2 trillion and 3 trillion.

item.title: Apple Intelligence approved for launch in China with Alibaba and Baidu
item.description: The deal, which was rumored to be in the works last year, marks an important step for Apple's AI ambitions in a key market.

item.title: Applied Computing wants to give oil and gas operators an AI model for the entire plant
item.description: Applied Computing has raised a $20M Series A to build a foundation AI model for the oil, gas and petrochemical industry.

item.title: Microsoft is reportedly training salespeople to talk down OpenAI and Anthropic
item.description: Microsoft is looking to sell its in-house AI models as more efficient and cost-effective than its competitors' models.

item.title: Amid hardware legal battle, OpenAI releases a $230 keyboard for Codex
item.description: OpenAI, which is in the middle of a legal battle with Apple over hardware trade theft allegations, just released a light-up keyboard designed to be paired with its agentic coding app.

item.title: SpaceX falls to $135 IPO price ahead of Starship launch
item.description: The stock has steadily fallen from the euphoric post-IPO high, showing that markets may be sobering up to the promises CEO Elon Musk made before and after SpaceX went public.

item.title: Thinking Machines amps up its bet against one-size-fits-all AI with its first open model, Inkling
item.description: It's the company's first public proof point after a year and a half spent building AI infrastructure largely out of public view.

item.title: Hack suggests AI music generator Suno scraped YouTube for training data
item.description: The hacker used an employee's credentials to access source code, which revealed how Suno scraped decades of audio.

item.title: Whatnot acquires Shaped to power real-time live shopping recommendations
item.description: Livestream shopping platform Whatnot has acquired AI startup Shaped, a machine learning company focused on real-time recommendations and search. The deal will bolster Whatnot’s personalization and discovery features as it expands into new product categories.

item.title: Microsoft patches record number of security vulnerabilities, citing its use of AI
item.description: Microsoft's monthly release of security fixes, dubbed Patch Tuesday, resolved a record 570 security vulnerabilities across the company's product line, thanks to discoveries with AI.

item.title: Inside Ode with Anthropic, the startup betting AI services are the future of enterprise
item.description: Can a handful of engineers really do the work of an army of consultants? That’s the bet behind Ode with Anthropic — the joint venture dedicated to embedding forward-deployed engineers in enterprise firms, backed by Anthropic, Blackstone, Hellman & Friedman, Goldman Sachs and others.   On this episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast, Rebecca Bellan sits down with Ode’s leaders Chris Taylor and Eddie Siegel, who founded Fractional AI, […]

item.title: Anthropic, Blackstone bet the next trillion-dollar AI business is implementation, not just models
item.description: Anthropic-backed Ode launches as AI labs bet that embedding forward-deployed engineers inside enterprises is the key to accelerating enterprise AI adoption.

item.title: Reelful’s AI turns your camera roll into short-form videos for social media
item.description: The app is designed for people who want to create social content, but find traditional video editing tools too complex or time-consuming.

item.title: Rime picks up $24M Series A to help enterprises field customer calls
item.description: Rime is handling over 100 million calls each month across multiple companies.

item.title: Indian AI coding startup Emergent becomes a unicorn with $130M Series C
item.description: The startup has reached a $120 million annualized revenue run rate and more than 200,000 paying customers.

item.title: Vint Cerf is working on a plan to unleash AI agents on the open internet
item.description: The guy behind TCP/IP is working on a standard for identifying AI agents in the wild.

item.title: OpenAI researcher Miles Wang in talks to launch AI drug discovery startup valued at $2B
item.description: The funding discussions point to investor interest in applying AI to make breakthroughs in life sciences.

item.title: Lorde says AI glasses are ‘not sexy’
item.description: "Increasingly in our world, it gets harder and harder to know what is real," Lorde said onstage.
